title: Framer story ticker
description: A two-line title with a small button over an edge-to-edge ticker of tall black hairline cards, each with a customer name centred and a "Read story →" link at its foot; the row glides left without end and a card lifts to a dark-grey fill on hover.
notes: the ticker is CSS (list rendered twice); with reduced motion it becomes a row you can scroll sideways
customer names are plain text in the display face; pass `mark` for a real logo
